def_en: The removable cover on the side of the computer case.
example_en: First, slide the side panel off the case.
example_es: Primero, desliza el panel lateral para sacarlo de la caja.

def_en: Small metal pieces that you turn with a screwdriver to fix parts together.
example_en: Use four screws to secure the power supply.
example_es: Usa cuatro tornillos para fijar la fuente de alimentación.

def_en: A small plastic or metal fastener that holds a component, like RAM, in place.
example_en: The clips lock the RAM when it snaps into place.
example_es: Los clips bloquean la RAM cuando encaja en su sitio.

def_en: A small cut in a component that helps you align it with its slot.
example_en: Align the notch on the RAM with the slot.
example_es: Alinea la muesca de la RAM con la ranura.

def_en: Any hardware that holds data, such as a hard drive or an SSD.
example_en: A hard drive is a storage device.
example_es: Un disco duro es un dispositivo de almacenamiento.

def_en: The built-in software that controls the basic functions of the computer.
example_en: Press a key to enter the BIOS menu.
example_es: Pulsa una tecla para entrar en el menú de la BIOS.

def_en: A component that gives the computer internet access by Wi-Fi.
example_en: The laptop has a wireless card, so it can connect to Wi-Fi.
example_es: El portátil tiene una tarjeta inalámbrica, así que puede conectarse al wifi.

es: unidad central (la caja con los componentes)
def_en: The main part of the computer that contains the internal components.
example_en: The system unit contains the motherboard and the power supply.
example_es: La unidad central contiene la placa base y la fuente de alimentación.

def_en: The main cord that connects the computer to an electrical source.
example_en: Unplug the power cable before you start.
example_es: Desenchufa el cable de alimentación antes de empezar.

def_en: A cooling system that uses liquid to remove the heat from the CPU.
example_en: Liquid cooling is quieter than a fan.
example_es: La refrigeración líquida es más silenciosa que un ventilador.

def_en: A cooling system that uses fans to move the heat away from the components.
example_en: Air cooling is cheaper than liquid cooling.
example_es: La refrigeración por aire es más barata que la líquida.

en: mini tower / mid tower / full tower
def_en: The common sizes of a computer case: small, medium and large.
example_en: A full tower is bigger than a mini tower.
example_es: Una torre grande es más grande que una torre pequeña.

es: separador (poste para atornillar la placa base)
def_en: A small metal post that raises the motherboard above the case.
example_en: Align the motherboard with the standoffs before you screw it.
example_es: Alinea la placa base con los separadores antes de atornillarla.
